'''The Reef,'''<ref name="BL" /> also known as '''The Reef asteroid cloud,'''<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref> was a natural belt of asteroids and dust that resulted from the collision of the two outmost planets in the [[Lamaro system]]. The natives of the system gave the belt its name.<ref name="BL" />

The Reef was a problem for [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogators]]. Pilots had to choose between leaving [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] outside the Lamaro system and then piloting manually to a planet at sublight speed, or using very precise coordinates.<ref name="BL" /> Ships crossing The Reef at hyperspeed were known to suffer from [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|hyperspace anomalies]] that destroyed components of the hyperdrive. Pilots suffering this fate had no option but landing in [[Bartyn's Landing]], the only starport of the system where replacements could be found.<ref name="R" />
